verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS identity-verification API and its Link SDK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any opt-out of telemetry, analytics or usage tracking. The cited items cover verification checks, webhooks, Link callbacks, reporting and Sandbox testing, none of which is an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
